subject.title: control-ui: expose reply-to metadata to agent sessions and avoid confusing no-output completion notices

question: Should maintainers keep this combined issue as the umbrella, or split it between structured Control UI/Gateway reply metadata and durable final-fallback delivery semantics?
rationale: The remaining work is real, but the permanent boundary spans UI request schema, Gateway protocol, agent runtime metadata, and channel delivery semantics, with existing related work already owning different slices.

options.title: Split Across Existing Work
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90745 or a maintainer replacement for structured reply metadata, keep no-output semantics in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/87561, and close this issue only after both halves are tracked clearly.

options.title: Keep As Umbrella
options.body: Leave this issue open as the coordination tracker until one maintainer-approved design covers both reply metadata and no-output UX.

options.title: Defer Structured Metadata
options.body: Treat current Markdown quote behavior as sufficient for Control UI for now and keep only the final-fallback contract active.

recommendation.title: Split Across Existing Work
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90745 or a maintainer replacement for structured reply metadata, keep no-output semantics in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/87561, and close this issue only after both halves are tracked clearly.

likelyOwner.reason: The current-main blame and recent area evidence cover the UI send path, Gateway schema, and runtime-context boundary that need coordination.
